item.text: {"summary":"The draft matches the ledger resolver and is broadly coherent, but the +1.5 million policy adjustment needs stronger quantitative support before publication.","requiredFixes":[{"rubricItem":"update","severity":"warning","summary":"The material move from the 19.1 million persistence prior to 21.0 million rests on an asserted +1.5 million effect from lowering the earned-income threshold, without cited evidence or a transparent eligibility/take-up calculation.","actionRequested":"Add a compact public-evidence bridge for the +1.5 million adjustment, such as an eligible low-earnings filer count, historical threshold sensitivity, or an explicit bracket explaining why the threshold-only effect is centered near +1.5 million rather than closer to 0 or to the 2021 ARPA gap."}],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify whether the historical Figure D values are being used only as comparable history while the resolver remains Table 3.3 first print.","The interval method is acceptable, but note that the 1.6 million policy-effect uncertainty is judgmental rather than estimated from realized volatility."]}
